LanguageData.ReplaceMountainRoofToNormalRoof: Replace Mountain Roof To Normal Roof
LanguageData.AutoAddBuildRoofAreaExplain: These Setting are good for Mountain Base
LanguageData.AutoReplaceThickRoof: Auto add Build Roof Area to Mountain Roof
LanguageData.ForceAddRoofArea: Auto add Build Roof Area to entire room, regardless of roof (Respect the Remove Roof Area) (See Tooltip)
LanguageData.TooltipForceAddRoofArea: It's disable, if toggle in the above is not enabled.
LanguageData.AllowPocketMaps: Allow roof replacement in pocket maps (Anomaly void, undercave, space pockets)
LanguageData.TooltipAllowPocketMaps: Off by default: those special dimensions manage their own roofs. Enable only if you actually want to convert them.
LanguageData.OnlyVanillaMountainRoof: Only replace vanilla mountain roof (ignore modded thick roofs)
LanguageData.TooltipOnlyVanillaMountainRoof: Off by default: any thick roof is replaceable, like the original mod. Enable to restrict replacement to the vanilla mountain roof only.
